001package dayplanner;
002
003
004
005import java.io.BufferedReader;
006import java.io.File;
007import java.io.FileReader;
008import java.io.FileWriter;
009import java.io.IOException;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011
012
013
014/**
015 * <p>
016 * Handles the application's file reads, writes, and deletion to separate these
017 * persistance details from the main code.
018 * </p>
019 * <p>
020 * The purpose of this class is to enable easy file operations based on a
021 * directory and file name, to cut down on boilerplate code in application
022 * classes.
023 * </p>
024 */
025public class FileUtils {
026    /**
027     * Default constructor (not used because all methods are static).
028     */
029    private FileUtils() {}
030
031
032
033    /**
034     * Reads every line from the named file.
035     *
036     * @param dirName  Directory containing the file.
037     * @param fileName Name of the file.
038     * @return The file's lines in order.
039     * @throws IOException If the file cannot be read.
040     */
041    public static ArrayList<String> readLines(String dirName, String fileName)
042    throws IOException {
043        ArrayList<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
044        File file = new File(dirName, fileName);
045
046        try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(file))) {
047            String line;
048            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null)
049                lines.add(line);
050        }
051
052        return lines;
053    }
054
055
056
057    /**
058     * Reads and trims the first line of the named file.
059     *
060     * @param dirName  Directory containing the file.
061     * @param fileName Name of the file.
062     * @return The trimmed first line.
063     * @throws IOException If the file cannot be read.
064     */
065    public static String readFirstLine(String dirName, String fileName)
066    throws IOException {
067        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(
068            new FileReader(
069                new File(dirName, fileName)));
070
071        String str = br.readLine().trim();
072        br.close();
073        return str;
074    }
075
076
077
078    /**
079     * Writes text to a file, creating its parent directories when needed.
080     *
081     * @param dirName Directory where the file will be saved.
082     * @param fileName Name of the target file.
083     * @param contents Text to write.
084     * @throws IOException If the file cannot be written.
085     */
086    public static void writeText(String dirName, String fileName, String contents)
087    throws IOException {
088        File file = new File(dirName, fileName);
089        File parent = file.getParentFile();
090
091        if (parent != null)
092            parent.mkdirs();
093
094        FileWriter fw = new FileWriter(file);
095        fw.write(contents);
096        fw.close();
097    }
098
099
100
101    /**
102     * Checks whether the named file exists.
103     * 
104     * @param dirName  Directory where the specified file is found.
105     * @param fileName Name of the specified file.
106     * @return <code>true</code> if the file exists, <code>false</code> otherwise.
107     */
108    public static boolean exists(String dirName, String fileName) {
109        return new File(dirName, fileName).exists();
110    }
111    
112
113
114    /**
115     * Deletes the named file if it exists.
116     * 
117     * @param dirName  Directory where the specified file is found.
118     * @param fileName Name of the specified file.
119     */
120    public static void delete(String dirName, String fileName) {
121        new File(dirName, fileName).delete();
122    }
123}
